newsitem.title: USA: Apache Medical sees Q4 loss $0.19-$0.22-shr.
newsitem.headline: Apache Medical sees Q4 loss $0.19-$0.22-shr.

text.p: Apache Medical Systems Inc said it expects to report a loss of between $0.19 per share and $0.22 per share for its fourth quarter, on revenue of about $2.6 million.
The per-share estimates do not include one-time charges for in-process research and development related to its acquisitions of Cardiomac and Health Research Network, the company said.
It said it expects to take a charge of between $500,000 and $800,000, or between $0.07 and $0.12 per share, for the acquisition of HRN.
It also expects a charge of between $1 million and $1.6 million, or between $0.15 and $0.23 per share, for the CardioMac acquisition, the company said.
CardioMac and HRN provide patient data.

The company also said it would take a charge of $1.1 million, or $0.16 per share, for unrecorded licensing and marketing fees arising from an earlier agreement with QIMC, a Cleveland-based health-care coalition.
The company said that HRN had revenue of about $900,000 in fiscal 1996 and its acquisition will make a positive contribution to its fiscal 1997 earnings. The company did not provide specific details.
Officials there were not immediately available to comment.
